messages.text: New entry point: buildDiagnosisDocument(input: DiagnosisDocumentInput): ReportDocument in server/report/reportModel.ts. Input = ReportInput (companyName, completedAt, result, timeZone?) + generatedAt: Date (required, only feeds the cover credit line) + brand?: ReportBrandInput (name/phone/email/site/logoDataUrl, all optional; blank means FitPulse) + actionProgress?: ReportActionProgress[] (actionKey, status todo|doing|done|notApplicable, dueDate DD/MM/AAAA or null, owner label or null, note or null, overdue boolean decided by the caller per RULE-ra-06; no entries means no 'Andamento das ações' page) + includeAnswers?: boolean (default false) + diagnosisInput?: DiagnosisInput ({answers, calculator} of the stored diagnosis). reportService must load and pass diagnosisInput ONLY when includeAnswers is on; with it off the builder never reads it, and with it on but missing it throws. Stable page ids: cover, executive-summary, dimensions, risks, numbers, action-progress (optional), how-to-read, answers-numbers, answers-1, answers-2, answers-3 (the last four only with answers).

For the PDF renderer unit: draw ReportDocument from shared/report/reportDocument.ts (blocks: cover, heading, paragraph, facts, keyNumbers, stage, actions, dimensionBars, riskMatrix, riskList, explainedNumbers, list, table, notice). One ReportPage is one A4 (throw if it does not fit); page.title is printed at the top of every page except the cover, which prints cover.title; footer.text goes on the left and 'Página N de M' on the right. Use PAPER_PALETTE and PAPER_TONE_COLORS from shared/report/paperPalette.ts. Constraints I could not verify without the renderer: (1) the risks page needs the 5x5 matrix beside the list, because 5 risks stacked under the matrix will not fit an A4; (2) bars carry scoreText and alertText plus the dashed line at threshold (50), so grayscale loses nothing; (3) the Inter latin subset does not carry U+2192, and none is used in the copy; (4) the cover brand logo is a data URL (PNG or JPEG), which pdfkit accepts. Remove the v1 phrase at pdfRenderer.ts:248 when moving to ReportDocument, then drop buildReportModel, ReportModel, GUIDANCE_NOTICE and NO_RISKS_TEXT (and their tests) from reportModel.ts.

ConfidenceNote.tsx must use shared/format/confidenceText.ts instead of its own describeConfidence (AC-ra-23): formatConfidenceStatement(confidence) gives 'Confiança nos dados: alta (1 de 26 itens sem o número)', always 'itens'; formatConfidence gives 'Alta (...)'; CONFIDENCE_LEVEL_EXPLANATIONS holds the sentence that follows. The preview should render the same ReportDocument the PDF draws: a page changed when its JSON differs for the same page.id; page.title is the title the PDF prints (the e2e comparison of preview titles with the PDF text relies on it); the riskMatrix block has 'description' (accessible name) and 'axesLabel'.

Assumptions made: (a) the executive summary shows stage, lock, 3 key numbers (cost per customer, profit ÷ cost ratio and payback; the third comes from the approved prototype), the 3 actions with 'Como fazer', the highest risk and the guidance warning; (b) the 'Seus números' page carries the 4 calculated numbers with their explanations plus the confidence paragraph (and the provisional note when low), so the v1 confidence section is not lost; (c) the answers appendix is the 6 calculator numbers (with the cost parts when the spend was typed in exact mode) on one page, then the 24 questions in 3 fixed pages of 8; (d) matrix legend ranges come from rulesV1 (Alto 16 a 25, Médio 6 a 15, Baixo 1 a 5), which differ from the prototype's hard-coded 8-15 and 1-7; (e) rulesV1 is used for the line of 50 and the risk thresholds because it is the only rules version. Evolution and portfolio documents are not built here; their units can reuse buildCoverPage, buildFooter, buildHowToReadPage and resolveBrand from documentParts.ts.

Deferred integration checks for this phase's capabilities, not run here: pdfRenderer.test.ts (page count equals document pages, text per page, summary on one page, bars with written score), tests/api/reportRoutes.test.ts for the new /api/reports/preview and /export, the Playwright report/result/accessibility specs, pnpm build, node scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs, aioson harness:check . --slug=relatorios-e-acompanhamento, and the dev-link walkthrough in the Play. pnpm exec tsc --noEmit already passes for the whole project with this unit's files.
